## 02 / Planning Tools

## Expert guidance to help you plan your trip

Things to Know

Arrive in Paris for the first time ready to tackle the city and every aspect of cultural nuance, safety and local etiquette.

[Read article](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/first-time-paris)

Best Neighborhoods

Skip the big sights and stroll Belleville instead, with its blend of multicultural charm, street art, bustling markets, and breathtaking views of Paris.

[Read article](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/lonely-planet-guide-to-belleville)

Day Trips

While it’s hard for anyone to leave Paris, these day trips offer bucolic nature, gorgeous cathedrals and more – all only an hour or so away.

[Read article](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/the-best-day-trips-from-paris)

Money and Costs

With savvy planning and a bit of local know-how, you'll find a wealth of ways to enjoy Paris without blowing your budget. Here are our top tips.

[Read article](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/paris-on-a-budget)

Transportation

Walking is the best way to explore Paris' individual neighborhoods, but you'll need the bus, metro and RER to go further afield.

[Read article](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/getting-around-paris)

Free Things to Do

Look beyond the French capital's most famous sights and you'll discover many free things to do in Paris – and get a local's perspective on the city too.

[Read article](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/top-free-things-to-do-in-paris)

5 Shops

Discover architectural jewelry, local design, vintage finds, and tiny treasures in Paris' independent shops and markets.

[Read article](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/paris-best-independent-shops)
